name: Chitose Haruki
source:
Our unlucky protagonist, he already treats his misfortunes as a part of his daily life. A tsundere, and unbelievably good at fighting. He shows his soft personality from time to time, and deeply cares about his companions. You can rely on him when the time counts.

[Edited from Mayoi's review]
